description: CN receiving scan flag dialog crashes when a shortfall quantity is entered: `flagQty.value.trim()` throws because Vue's v-model on `<input type="number">` auto-casts the value to a number (isNumberInput in vModelText), so `.trim()` is not a function and the flag cannot be submitted
reproSteps: CN receiving scan → open a group's 標記 dialog → enter a number in the 短缺數量 field → submit → TypeError: flagQty.value.trim is not a function (apps/pda/pages/receiving-cn-scan/[id].vue:204)
remarks: Found while capturing user-guide screenshots (docs/user-guide/capture-runbook.md). Fix: coerce with String(flagQty.value).trim() or drop .trim() and validate Number(flagQty.value) directly
